1.consolidated_definition: Revisar, evaluar. Formar opinión sobre algo o alguien. Calco de estructura, frecuente. En vista de ello, el tribunal de instancia resolvió que no tenía jurisdicción para reabrir el caso y pasar juicio sobre un asunto que pudo haberse levantado (Tribunal Supremo, 30-03-06)
1.en_consolidated_definition: To review, to evaluate. To form an opinion about something or someone. Calque of structure, frequent. In view of this, the trial court resolved that it did not have jurisdiction to reopen the case and pass judgment on a matter that could have been raised (Supreme Court, 30-03-06)
